name: component-label-label-06
title: Label 6
description: Label with status indicator linked to a select control.

files.content: import { useId, useState } from 'react' import { Field } from '@astrale-os/ui/field' import { Label } from '@astrale-os/ui/label' import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@astrale-os/ui/select' const items = [ { label: 'Online', value: 'online' }, { label: 'Offline', value: 'offline' }, { label: 'Busy', value: 'busy' }, { label: 'Away', value: 'away' } ] const SelectWithLabel = () => { const id = useId() const [status, setStatus] = useState('online') const statusColors: Record = { online: 'bg-green-600 dark:bg-green-400', offline: 'bg-destructive', busy: 'bg-sky-600 dark:bg-sky-400', away: 'bg-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-400' } return ( ) } export default SelectWithLabel
